file_format.filename_rules: ISO date first for chronological sort; '_' separates fields, '-' joins tokens within a field; uppercase 3-letter IFAF team codes

columns.name: PLAY #
columns.note: identity source of play_id; contiguous 1..N per game

columns.name: ODK
columns.note: forward-only hardening; legacy ODK is polluted (team names, formation strings) and takes the grandfathered ingest path

columns.name: YARD LN
columns.note: signed convention: negative = own territory, positive = yards to opponent goal

columns.name: RESULT
columns.matching: exact token match after split on separator, case-sensitive
columns.note: non-empty forward-only (23% of legacy plays are empty and silently become 'pass'). C-07 amendment: 'No Good' and 'Fumble' added to the C-07 token list; Fumble semantics PENDING-ANALYST. Replaces the fragile str.contains substring semantics.

columns.name: GN/LS
columns.note: informational, non-authoritative; yards gained are derived from yardline_50 deltas

columns.name: DEF FRONT
columns.note: canonical vocabulary fixed only after sighting real distinct values from sample exports (Plan 02)

columns.name: COVERAGE
columns.note: canonical vocabulary fixed only after sighting real distinct values from sample exports (Plan 02)

columns.name: BLITZ
columns.note: canonical vocabulary fixed only after sighting real distinct values from sample exports (Plan 02)

columns.name: QTR
columns.note: essentially never filled; not consumed by the pipeline

drive_id.rule: increment on O/D possession flip; scoring/turnover RESULT (TD, Def TD, Safety, Interception, Fumble-if-turnover) also closes a drive

game_id.rule: parsed from filename_pattern; assigned by ingest from parsed filename

posteam.rule: PENDING-ANALYST: ODK charting perspective for exchanged opponent film unresolved; proposal on the agenda: TEAM1 in filename = perspective team
